selection_policy: Explicit local inspection allowlist. No private holdouts, unclassified research outputs or blanket repository export. Monograph text, original figures and TeX source are CC BY 4.0; listed new maintained computational companion files are MIT. LICENSES/README.md defines the scope and preserves third-party and inherited terms.

groups.title: Worked teaching examples
groups.scope: Exact small calculations accompanying the whole-monograph exposition pass, with section names, symbolic residuals and source hashes.
groups.limit: Finite symbolic examples only; no general theorem, global geometric realization or historical numerical campaign is verified by these checks.

groups.title: Sections 1–8 and Appendix A: exact finite normalizations
groups.scope: Rational fixtures for perimeter and Gram determinants, stack factors, cone walls, intersections, Pfaffians and SL₂ trace identities.
groups.limit: Finite identities for the named fixtures. No general moduli integral, divisor theorem or geometric realization is computed.

groups.title: Section 9: volume Hessians and barrier examples
groups.scope: The unchanged grid and dense barrier results belong to the frozen Section 9 checkpoint. Its complete reproduction archives remain available from the historical companion pages above.
groups.limit: Small supplied fixtures, numerical comparisons and finite exact identities. No nearly-linear solver, global embedding or interval optimality certificate is supplied.

groups.title: Sections 12–14 and 16: periods and surgery
groups.scope: Finite period, fusion and local peripheral/surgery calculations with their original recorded coordinates, precision and source identities.
groups.limit: Local formulas and fixed examples. No full quantum gluing, geometric Dehn-filling solver or branch-independent Gaussian phase is certified.

groups.title: Section 15: regular-family Airy evidence
groups.scope: The exact-integrand companion supplies new numerical quadrature with precision, contour and cutoff comparisons. The earlier finite algebra and historical input values remain separately downloadable.
groups.limit: The original Airy evaluator and its raw error record remain unrecovered. The later calculation is independent evidence, not a replay of that missing evaluator; neither supplies a total interval certificate.

groups.title: Quantum and geodesic finite checks
groups.scope: Four finite quantum groups and ten finite geodesic groups support Sections 10–11, 17–22, 32 and Appendix B. A separate Section 10.1 teaching example compares exact equal-spin Wigner 6j values with their Euclidean Ponzano–Regge approximation. Each report retains its own evidence status.
groups.limit: No general Jones or root-of-unity 6j evaluator, global moduli/GMC solver, numerical asymptotic theorem, arbitrary realization or geometric completeness result is claimed.

groups.title: Sections 23–31: finite counting and mixing formulas
groups.scope: Exact and numerical finite checks accompany the coefficient, dynamics and arithmetic formulas; the result retains its clean-source checkpoint provenance.
groups.limit: Finite checks do not prove the stated global counting or mixing implications and do not supply their independent analytic hypotheses.

groups.title: Section 30: torus diagnostics and preserved predecessor
groups.scope: The maintained full diagnostic through length 8192 is supplied alongside the frozen length-64 predecessor. Each result keeps its own inputs, precision and source record.
groups.limit: The original historical high-length precision archive remains unrecovered. These replacement diagnostics do not certify a global sharp asymptotic or recover the original campaign.
